name: StepCraft M.1000 (WinPC-NC)
notes: CHECK THESE AGAINST YOUR MACHINE. Travel is the catalogue working area and Z depends on which gantry/spindle mount you have. max_feed and rapid are what WinPC-NC is configured to, not what the catalogue claims -- read them off Parameters > Speeds. max_rpm assumes an AMB/Kress-class router (5000-25000); an HF spindle on a VFD differs. Tool changes are by hand, hence the one pocket and the 60 s. S is only obeyed if WinPC-NC actually controls the spindle; with a hand-dialled AMB, set the dial to the S value in the header.
